headline: GTA VI extended look got 31.1M views on Netflix despite six-hour exclusivity window
summary: The almost 30-minute video of the upcoming game was Netflix's top movie for the last week of August, ranking #1 in 58 countries despite a short six-hour exclusivity window.
details: Grand Theft Auto VI's extended look garnered an impressive 31.1 million views on Netflix during its brief six-hour exclusivity window from August 27. It quickly became the top movie on Netflix for the last week of August, securing the #1 spot in 58 countries.

After the Netflix exclusivity period ended, Rockstar Games uploaded the extended trailer to its YouTube account, where it has accumulated over 17.7 million views. It's important to note that Netflix counts a complete viewing as one view, whereas YouTube adds to its view count as soon as a video is played.

The nearly 30-minute video showcases in-game footage from the PlayStation 5 version of GTA VI. It highlights combat changes, expansions to the game's universe, the ability to swap between main characters, and various side activities.
GTA VI is set to be released on November 19. Players can expect a substantial experience, with the main story estimated to take up to or more than 80 hours to complete.
